runway.flavor: a flat, mostly-open run-up stretch — clear flat ground so the player can build running speed for what comes next; keep it easy and readable, a breather between challenges

gauntlet.flavor: a platforming gauntlet — mostly air and platforms with little solid ground, a rhythm of deliberate jumps over gaps and hazards; a couple of gaps may be WIDE run-and-jump challenges (with runway before them)

cave.flavor: a tight, enclosed cave — low ceilings and narrow passages, claustrophobic, threading between walls and hazards; the kind of place that hides a secret niche or two off the main path

islands.flavor: scattered islands over a pit or water — hop from platform to platform, the ground below is a fall or a swim, with floating water clouds to swim up through or drift across

vault.flavor: a hidden treasure vault — a small sealed chamber stacked with riches; shelves and ledges holding secret rewards, gentle terrain with no danger; the prize is the point, make it feel like a discovery

lair.flavor: a monster's den — an open arena chamber with room to fight; mostly clear floor with a few flanking platforms to jump between, built for one dangerous encounter

reef.flavor: a submerged reef — coral shelves and staggered ledges to weave through, urchin thickets guarding the narrow passes; built to be SWUM, with generous open water between features

trench.flavor: a deep ocean trench — sheer rock walls and carved channels, a drowned canyon the player swims down into and threads through; mines drift near the seabed

climb.flavor: a vertical climb — ascend a rising stack of staggered platforms and ledges toward an exit at the TOP; float up through water clouds where a jump alone won't carry you
